summary: Enable Settings > Platform gateway > 'Allow external users to create OAuth2 tokens' so users can sign in to the portal through AAP; users who cannot log in to AAP (for example removed from LDAP, SAML or Azure) cannot log in to the portal.
questions: How do I allow external users to create OAuth2 tokens?
LDAP users cannot log in to self-service automation portal
Why can't SAML users sign in to the portal?

answer_card.title: Allow external users to create OAuth2 tokens
answer_card.answer_md:
Needed so LDAP/SAML/Azure users can sign in to the portal through AAP.

1. Log in to AAP as admin.
2. **Settings > Platform gateway > Edit platform gateway settings**.
3. Set *Allow external users to create OAuth2 tokens* to **Enabled** and save.

Users who can't log in to AAP (e.g. removed from the IdP) can't log in to the portal either.
